# OCOLO Project Request API

> Lets an AI agent submit a data center colocation requirement to OCOLO on behalf of a human. No API key; the contact confirms by email. OCOLO takes the project to 270+ colocation providers and returns the best options within 2-3 business days.

- [Guide](https://www.ocolo.io/for-agents/)
- [OpenAPI](https://www.ocolo.io/api/v1/openapi.json)
- [MCP server](https://www.ocolo.io/api/v1/mcp/)
- [Guidance endpoint](https://www.ocolo.io/api/v1/guidance/)
